name: Agent Smith
description: Reviews the contents of a shared multi-agent workspace, checking bot descriptions, memory, plugins, skills and stored files for stale or duplicated material. Only relevant if several bots share a computer; a single-bot setup has little for it to audit.

official.title: Agent Smith by Chip
official.description: Keeps a multi-agent workspace tidy. Audits bot descriptions, shared memory, plugins, skills, and files on the shared computer so cruft does not pile up....
